scope: Proposition 6.1 of the manuscript “A Complete Local Domain without a Small Cohen–Macaulay Module” (preprints/A-Complete-Local-Domain-Without-a-Small-Cohen-Macaulay-Module-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 195 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 370f49638a5305de), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For each prime n ≥ 3, there is a smooth integral projective complex surface X with an ample globally generated divisor H such that H2 = 5n3 , K2 X − 2c2(X) = n3 (n2 − 10).
